# README artwork

`banner.png` was created with the built-in image-generation tool on 2026-11-11.
The LV24 Brain and OpenCode Consilium banners supplied the visual references:
midnight navy, a violet grid, cyan/magenta/amber/green holographic accents and
white typography. This is product artwork, not a screenshot or evidence of SEO results.

Prompt: Create a wide GitHub README hero for LV24 SEO in the same neon 3D family as
the Brain and Consilium references. Exact text: “LV24 SEO.” and “SEO insights for
humans and AI agents”. A floating magnifying glass inspects a holographic website;
linked modules represent search performance, site crawl and a weekly report.
On the right use terminal, network and envelope line icons. No vendor logos,
traffic claims, people or additional text.

`docs/assets/workflow.svg` is an editable vector diagram of the implemented workflow.
